script.problem: It has 3 sentences. A meaning is 1 or 2 sentences.

terra.problem: “His Lord, Jesus” sounds as if Jesus is God’s Lord. Jesus is David’s Lord. Also, the meaning should explain that sitting at God’s right hand shows Jesus’ exalted position and authority, not just His presence with God. Gill says David’s body remained in the grave, though his soul was in heaven; the statement that David did not go up to heaven should be clarified.
